rows: Generalist who writes on any topic

Writer who also does strategy, SEO or product messaging
Good

Writer building an audience of their own
High variance
It can scale, but it takes years and most do not reach it.

blocks.heading: Careers That Can Beat Generic Content Writing
rows: Technical writing
Pay rewards product depth, and demand is tied to product teams.
You need to understand the product and often basic code.
Product marketing or content strategy
Pay follows business results and decisions, not volume.
Fewer entry roles and more competition for them.
UX writing
Interface copy is tied directly to product outcomes.
Smaller number of roles, and design tool fluency.
